whatsappMessage:
Hi Biryani King A Family Restaurant Team,

I noticed your restaurant has established strong engagement with 714+ reviews in Khagaul, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for direct table reservations and home delivery orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, family dining menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://biryani-king-patna-demo.netlify.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Biryani King team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Biryani King A Family Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering and family menu showcase for your Khagaul location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur contact setup karke live kar sakte hain."
